title: 3 tier serving platter
text: 3 tier serving platter. I have a long, rectangle table that use something like a buffet table with I have gatherings.  These fit perfectly and kind of "break the scene" of the one dimensional lines of all flat plates.  The 3 tier frame that holds the plates is a thicker wire.  The frame is black, the plates are ceramic and white.  I did wash the plates in the dishwasher with no issues.  The wire frame when up is sturdy, but don't move it around a lot when in use.  The wire  frame disassembles very easily for storage.  I like them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Serving Tray White/Black
features: VERSATILE SERVING TRAY: A 3 tier tray for any of your serving needs! This serving platter will hold any kind of food, dessert, or appetizer. Use it to serve and display cake pops, deviled eggs, fruit, egg rolls, donuts, & so much more.
ELEGANT & CHIC: This tiered platter set includes a gold metal stand that holds up 3 white rectangular plates, giving off a modern look that's sure to elevate your next tea party or brunch.
DURABLE CERAMIC: These ceramic serving dishes are built to last. Each ceramic tray is strong enough to hold a large amount of food without wobbling or collapsing.

EASY CARE: These serving platters make hosting easy! The trays are microwave safe so you can reheat your side dishes whenever you need, as well as dishwasher safe to make the post party cleanup so much easier.

EASY ASSEMBLY: This serving set includes three 12" serving plates + 1 gold stand that's simple to assemble altogether to create your 3 tiered tray stand. The serving platter stand is also just as easy to disassemble, making it convenient to store when not in use.
